open_questions: FONT: render.py measures text widths with PIL ImageFont. It needs Segoe UI (Windows). On Linux it falls back to DejaVu Sans (or PIL's default), which changes label widths and therefore layout, so the server output will not match this proof. Decide: ship a bundled open font (and regenerate expected output), or accept the fallback. T2PW_DIAGRAM_FONT overrides the path.

PACKAGING: diagram.css must be listed in pyproject.toml [tool.setuptools.package-data] to ship in a wheel. pyproject.toml is outside this lane's boundary; it works from a source tree and editable installs.
Pillow is imported at module import time (render.py); it is in requirements.txt (Pillow>=10.0.0) but not checked against pyproject dependencies.
render_html uses system-ui fonts; the prototype page used Google Fonts links (network), left out on purpose.
ImageFont.load_default(size) needs Pillow >= 10.1; only reached when no listed font exists.
